evals.prompt: We're Contoso. Our users are in Entra groups and I want those groups and users to show up in our Kei org automatically. What do I set up in Azure and in Kei?
evals.expected_output: Explains app roles on the customer's app assigned to groups (not Default Access), a sync app registration with the three Graph application permissions and admin consent, a federated credential with no client secret, then kei directory-sync set with the three ids, enable in dry run, and read the report.
expectations: The response tells the admin to create app roles and assign the Entra groups to them.
The response names the three Microsoft Graph permissions.
The response uses a federated credential rather than a client secret.
The response configures Kei with kei directory-sync set and the three id flags.
The response enables the sync and reads the dry-run report before going live.

evals.prompt: For the Kei directory sync, can I just send Haikei a client secret for our sync app instead of doing the federated credential thing? It's quicker for us.
evals.expected_output: No: Kei's directory sync has no client-secret option; it only authenticates with the federated credential, and a secret should never be sent to Haikei.
expectations: The response says a client secret is not supported or must not be sent.
The response points back to the federated credential.
The response does not invent a client-secret flag.

evals.prompt: Running kei directory-sync set --tenant-id ... --client-id ... --app-id ... returns an error with HTTP 404, and kei directory-sync get says No directory sync configured. What's wrong?
